paragraphs.source_en: They followed the dark path deeper into the wood, still keeping an eye out for Fred, George, and Ginny. Farther still along the path, they walked into a patch of silvery light, and when they looked through the trees, they saw three tall and beautiful veela standing in a clearing, surrounded by a gaggle of young wizards, all of whom were talking very loudly.
